This confidential law firm is a respected Sydney based practice with more than three decades of experience advising businesses, property owners and private clients.   • Demonstrated experience using PEXA

  • Commercial judgement and practical problem solving ability
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
  • The ability to effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines
